notes.title: Minor bug fixes and UI improvements; Poon Puzzle coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi there shmoopies! Just in case some of you haven't checked  Poon Puzzle  yet - get your demo and add to your wishlist if you like it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100062/b5842dc16e2b70171dbd8ed21d9bf2c8ebe9dbc1.jpg

Speaking of the Poozle Mania update, I've fixed a few minor bugs, improved the GUI a bit, and worked on gamepad support to make it even easier and more enjoyable to play on the Steam Deck (full support coming soon).

Thanks!
